This repository produces `vis42.mcpb`, an MCP Bundle for Claude Desktop. Its Node.js stdio-to-HTTP proxy forwards MCP operations to `https://vis42.com/api/mcp`. References: [MCPB MANIFEST.md](https://github.com/anthropics/mcpb/blob/main/MANIFEST.md) | [Architecture overview](https://github.com/anthropics/mcpb/blob/main/README.md).

The proxy must answer Claude Desktop's `initialize` immediately. Remote connection is deferred: connect lazily on the first request (`getRemoteClient()`); never block in startup.

Transport **constructors never throw**. Errors surface only when `client.connect()` is awaited. SSE fallback must wrap the `connect()` call, not the constructor: create `StreamableHTTPClientTransport`, await `client.connect(transport)`, then on failure create `SSEClientTransport` and await `client.connect(sseTransport)`; let SSE errors throw naturally.

All log output must go to `stderr`. `stdout` is the MCP protocol channel. Use `process.stderr.write(...)`; never use `console.log` for debug output.

Tools are stripped to `{ name, description }` only; omit runtime hints. Prompt arguments in the manifest are string names, not objects: map `p.arguments` to `a.name`. `resources` is **not a valid manifest field**. The pack validator rejects it. Skip resources in the manifest; `resources/list`, `resources/read`, and `resources/templates/list` are handled at runtime.

The `toJSON()` expression in GitHub Actions produces `"null"` for absent fields. Use `JSON.parse(process.env.SOME_JSON || 'null') || []` to handle absent/null payload fields.

Use `env:` variables for all payload data. Never interpolate `client_payload` fields directly in `run:` scripts. Example: `DATA: ${{ toJSON(github.event.client_payload.tools) }}`; read with `JSON.parse(process.env.DATA)`.

Manifest: `manifest_version` is `"0.3"` (Manual; Do not change); `name` (Manual); `version` (CI; synced with `server/package.json`); `tools` and `prompts` (CI; stripped tools, arguments as string names); `resources` — **Never**, not in schema; `tools_generated` and `prompts_generated` (Manual; omit or false for static entries); `user_config` (Manual; `api_token` injected as `VIS42_API_TOKEN`); `compatibility` (Manual; `claude_desktop >= 0.10.0`, `node >= 18`, `darwin` + `win32`).

Two files must always have the same semver version: `manifest.json` → `.version` and `server/package.json` → `.version`. CI writes
